summary.prose: Building this Story means wrapping the one existing codex subprocess call inside readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch with a narrow catch: when that call fails with codex's own live-confirmed bootstrap-rejection wording, the failure is translated into a new, named CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError identifying the unexcludable server; every other failure, and the already-working success path, passes through completely unchanged. No new subprocess calls, no reordering of the existing discovery/argv-build/exec flow.

tasks.title: Add CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError and catch-translate it in readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch
tasks.summary: Export a new `CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError extends Error` class carrying `serverName`. Wrap the existing `this.runCodex(codexReadOnlySessionArgs(...), ...)` call inside readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch (cli-provider.ts:741) in a try/catch: on catch, read `err instanceof CliExitError ? err.said : (err as Error).message`, match it against codex's live-confirmed bootstrap-rejection pattern ('Error loading config.toml: invalid transport in `mcp_servers.<name>`'); on a match throw `CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError(name)` with the extracted server name, else re-throw the original error unchanged. No other step in readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch (walkProjectMcpConfigLayers, schema temp file, discoverCodexMcpServers, budget recompute, codexReadOnlySessionArgs, reply parsing) is reordered or modified.
acceptanceChecks: CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError is exported from cli-provider.ts with a readonly serverName field
readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch catches a runCodex failure and translates it per the pattern match, with every other step in the branch unchanged in order and behavior
a failure that does not match the pattern is re-thrown exactly as before (same type, same message)

tests.name: readOnlySessionOnce throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError('codex_app') when runCodex's failure message matches codex's live-confirmed bootstrap-rejection wording naming codex_app

tasks.title: Unit test the new failure-translation path with a scripted fake codex binary
tasks.summary: Extend the existing fake-codex test harness (cli-readonly-session.test.ts) to script a non-zero exit whose stderr is the exact live-confirmed bootstrap-rejection text naming a given server, and add unit tests: readOnlySessionOnce throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError('codex_app') and CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError('cua_repl') on the matching message; proceeds normally (no new error) when the servers list includes node_repl and runCodex succeeds; re-throws the original, unmodified error when the failure does not match the pattern (e.g. a generic non-zero exit or the existing 'no agent_message item' case).
acceptanceChecks: ac1's two unit tests (codex_app, cua_repl) pass against the fake codex harness
ac2's unit test (node_repl success, unaffected) passes
ac3's unit test (non-matching failure re-thrown unchanged, same type and message) passes
no existing test in cli-readonly-session.test.ts or cli-codex-strict-schema.test.ts regresses

tests.name: readOnlySessionOnce throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError('codex_app') when runCodex's failure message matches codex's live-confirmed bootstrap-rejection wording naming codex_app
readOnlySessionOnce throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError('cua_repl') when runCodex's failure message matches the same wording naming cua_repl
readOnlySessionOnce proceeds normally (no new error) when the servers list includes node_repl and runCodex succeeds, exactly as today

readOnlySessionOnce re-throws the original, unmodified error when runCodex fails for a reason that does NOT match the bootstrap-rejection wording (e.g. a generic non-zero exit, or the existing 'no agent_message item' case)

tasks.title: Live-test the refusal and success paths against the real codex binary
tasks.summary: Add INSRC_LIVE_TESTS=1-gated live tests: a real runReadOnlySession call whose discovered servers include codex_app or cua_repl throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError naming that server and never starts a session (no tool from any server reachable); a real call whose discovered servers include node_repl (and insrc) succeeds and starts a restricted session as today; confirm the previously-covered misregistration, budget/cancellation, and project-config-refusal live tests remain unaffected.
acceptanceChecks: live: codex_app or cua_repl in the discovered servers list throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError naming that server, no session starts
live: node_repl in the discovered servers list starts a restricted session successfully, as today
live: existing misregistration / budget-cancellation / project-config-refusal tests still pass unchanged
